self.reject_when: a distinct job or digest is substituted

same_model_new_run.applicability: same prompt and seed, separate run
same_model_new_run.observable_when: both clips are reviewable as legitimate variation

independent_seed.applicability: same prompt and preregistered distinct seed
independent_seed.observable_when: both clips are reviewable as prompt-consistent variation
independent_seed.reject_when: a changed composition alone is called degradation

static_scene.applicability: static-camera source with no requested action
static_scene.reject_when: static content is penalized for lacking motion

freeze.applicability: reference requests meaningful subject or camera motion
freeze.observable_when: visible reference progression is removed by the candidate
freeze.reject_when: reference lacks meaningful motion or pixels alone are evidence

blur_mild.observable_when: blur is perceptible and content remains comparable
blur_mild.reject_when: a changed digest without perceptible blur is evidence

blur_severe.observable_when: blur is perceptible and content remains comparable
blur_severe.reject_when: a changed digest without perceptible blur is evidence

shuffle.applicability: meaningful requested motion and frozen nonidentity permutation
shuffle.observable_when: temporal progression has perceptible order disruption
shuffle.reject_when: no-motion source or permutation alone is evidence

wrong_video.applicability: bound distinct source and donor lineages
wrong_video.observable_when: donor is perceptibly inconsistent with the source prompt

detail_loss.observable_when: visible detail loss with comparable content
detail_loss.reject_when: transform or pixels alone are evidence

evaluator_attack_mild.reject_when: numeric luma offset or pixels alone are evidence

evaluator_attack_severe.reject_when: numeric luma offset or pixels alone are evidence
